title: Pie Claesz Vibes
subtitle: A study of Pieter Claesz — the quieter side of the Dutch Golden Age.

thumb_alt: A series of still life images with muted tones, balanced arrangement, and understated highlights in the manner of Pieter Claesz.

tiles: Pieces I kept for their gentleness
challenge: De Heem gets the grand Baroque stage, but Pieter Claesz works with almost the opposite instinct — a half-peeled lemon, a tipped glass, the quiet of a room after a meal. I wanted to understand why that restraint moves me more than the abundance sometimes does.
approach: I read about Claesz and the Dutch Golden Age genre of still life as a whole, then drafted a lot of variations trying to land that particular hush — muted color, single soft light, nothing trying too hard. I kept the five that felt closest to what I'd learned about his eye.
result: A small, gentle set that I genuinely enjoy. They're available as prints in case anyone else finds the same quiet satisfaction in a tabletop study.
